thread:
Ava: Quick flag — we've got multiple tickets where folks expect the console 'Save' button to create a temporary compare snapshot, not a persisted saved query. But our telemetry/quotas count them the same. This is confusing and inflates savedquery metrics. Thoughts?
Liam: Do we have examples of the offending flows?
Ava: Yes — support ticket 3421 and a few product sessions. Users do a quick 'save' while iterating then delete; they don't want it to show up in team lists.
Priya: So we need two concepts: ephemeral (session-scoped) vs persistent (team-scoped). UX should surface a tiny toggle maybe. :bulb:
Noah: From UI side that's straightforward. Backend needs a flag on the saved-query object. Suggest field: `lifecycle: "ephemeral" | "persistent"` and `visibility: "me" | "team"`
Liam: Agreed. Also quota/telemetry needs to know whether ephemeral counts against saved-query quota or not. Maybe ephemeral gets a separate counter.
Priya: For telemetry I want attribution to still show up in route/model Insights, but not in the "Saved queries" quota dashboard. So telemetry events should include `saveset_type` and `session_id` when ephemeral.
Ava: Important: routing policies — ephemeral saves should inherit current route/model pins but not create a persistent rollout pin. They should be read-only for routing rules.
Noah: On the Console, ephemeral items could be shown under "My Drafts" and have a small clock icon. Persistent items remain searchable.
Liam: Implementation notes: DB change minimal — add `lifecycle` enum and `created_by_session` boolean. Migration: existing rows -> persistent.
Liam: Quick pseudo-migration:
```
ALTER TABLE saved_queries ADD COLUMN lifecycle text DEFAULT 'persistent';
UPDATE saved_queries SET lifecycle='persistent' WHERE lifecycle IS NULL;
```

Priya: For telemetry events, example payload we want: `{\"event\": \"save_query\", \"lifecycle\": \"ephemeral\", \"route\": \"r-123\", \"model\": \"m-qual\", \"session_id\": \"s-abc\"}`
Ava: UX copy: toggle label could be "Save as draft (won't count against saved queries)" — Priya can you draft wording?
Priya: On it. I'll draft two variants and post in #product for quick review.
Noah: I'll do a small UI spike today. Will surface toggle and the draft bucket.
Liam: I'll spike the API and add the migration in a branch. We should gate rollout behind a feature flag for 2 weeks to monitor telemetry delta.
Ava: Good. Also need to update the Console quotas dashboard to exclude `lifecycle=ephemeral` by default, maybe add a filter to include them for debugging.
Priya: Caveat: some teams used saves as persistent accidentally. We'll need a migration email or a modal explaining differences when they first hit upgraded console.
Ava: Agreed — add a small onboarding toast during rollout.
deploy-bot: Design doc updated: <https://redwood.internal/docs/savesets-ux-proposal|savesets-ux-proposal> — version 0.1 deployed to staging.
Noah: Nice. I'll check staging and share screenshots. :eyes: 
Liam: Action items: Priya (UX copy + telemetry schema), Noah (UI spike + screenshots), Liam (API + migration PR), Ava (rollout plan + messaging).
Ava: Thanks team — let's sync tomorrow 11am to sign off on the rollout gating thresholds.
